metaAds.confirmPause: "{{name}}" will be PAUSED. Are you sure?

metaAds.noAdsets: No ad sets in this campaign.

metaAds.recConfirmPause: Applying recommendation: "{{name}}" will be PAUSED. Are you sure?

metaAds.setMinKillSpendHint: No kill suggestion below this 7d spend

metaAds.setFrequencyHint: Creative fatigue warning when 7d frequency exceeds this
metaAds.setCtrDropHint: Warn when last-7d CTR drops this much vs previous 7d

metaAds.abCompleteConfirm: The test will be completed — winner: {{winner}}. Are you sure?
metaAds.abNoMetrics: Metrics unavailable (campaigns may not be visible in this account).
metaAds.createPausedNote: The campaign, ad set and ad are created PAUSED — no spending until you activate them. Fine-tune in Meta Ads Manager.
metaAds.createBudgetLevel: CBO = campaign budget, ABO = ad set budget
metaAds.createTargetingNote: Targeting: Turkey, automatic placements (Advantage+). Use Meta Ads Manager for interest/detailed targeting.

metaAds.createConfirm: Campaign + ad set (+ ad) will be created PAUSED. Continue?

metaStrategies.title: Strategy Hub
metaStrategies.desc: Meta ad strategies — each strategy runs step by step: analyses run automatically, actions run with your approval and everything is created PAUSED.
metaStrategies.activateConfirm: The strategy will be activated. Analysis steps run automatically; action steps that create anything on Meta still run with your approval and everything opens PAUSED. Continue?
metaStrategies.rationale: Why this strategy? (rationale, evidence and risks)
metaStrategies.configHint: Values are parsed as JSON: number, "text", [list] or null. Step descriptions explain each field.
metaStrategies.deleteRunConfirm: Delete run "{{title}}"? (Only runs that haven't built a Meta campaign can be deleted.)
metaStrategies.archiveRunConfirm: Archive "{{title}}"? The Meta campaign is not affected; the record stays listed as 'archived'.
metaStrategies.vtCreateRunHint: Each run is a separate video campaign: after opening it you pick video pairs from Creative Studio, enter the settings, build it PAUSED and publish with one click. Existing campaigns are never touched.
metaStrategies.vtHint: Pick one vertical (9:16) + one square (1:1) video per template from your Creative Studio renders. Each pair becomes one ad: vertical plays in Stories/Reels, square in feed. Save the settings, then hit Run on the "Add to ads" step below — everything is created PAUSED.
metaStrategies.vtAutoPairEmpty: No pairs found — a template needs both a completed vertical and square video.
metaStrategies.vtCampaignExists: This strategy already built a campaign: {{id}}. Finish its publish decision first; a new campaign requires a new strategy cycle.
metaStrategies.vtAdvantage: Advantage+ audience (recommended — the account's best campaigns run this way)
metaStrategies.vtRunHint: After saving, the Run button on the "Add to ads (PAUSED)" step builds a SEPARATE NEW campaign with these settings — existing campaigns are never touched; publishing is your call.
metaStrategies.skipConfirm: This step will be skipped. Are you sure?
metaStrategies.runActionConfirm: This step CREATES a brand-new campaign (with its adset/ad) in your Meta account — existing campaigns are not touched, everything opens PAUSED, no spending starts. Continue?
metaStrategies.safetyNote: Safety: no strategy ever starts delivery on its own and existing campaigns are NEVER touched — every Meta setup happens under a freshly created separate campaign, PAUSED; going live is always your decision.
metaStrategies.runsEmpty: No runs yet — pick a category and start the first run.
metaStrategies.offersHint: One per line: "50% off 2nd item", "3 installments, no interest", "Free shipping"… The angle matrix is built from these plus automatic concepts (comfort/lifestyle/returns/social proof).
metaStrategies.creativesEmpty: No creatives yet — images will appear here once the creative production step starts.
metaStrategies.createRunHint: Everything else is automatic: products from category intelligence, audience from the category, creative strategy from your messages. Everything is created PAUSED; publishing requires your approval.
metaStrategies.regenReasonPrompt: What's wrong with this image? Briefly (optional) — helps me regenerate it better.
metaStrategies.approveWithPendingConfirm: You requested regeneration for {{count}} image(s) but they're not produced yet. Approve and move to the next step anyway?
metaStrategies.creativeApprovalHint: Review the images; use the regenerate button on any faulty one to request a fix. Once you're happy with all of them, approve — the next step (pre-launch audit) opens then.
metaStrategies.settingsLockedHint: Settings are locked because the campaign is built — change the live budget from the Campaigns tab, or creatives with a new run.
metaStrategies.approveCreativesConfirm: You are approving all creatives in the gallery. Approval means the ads are ready to go live with these visuals (publishing is still your call). Continue?
metaStrategies.strategyGalleryHint: Final versions of the visuals used in the ads. Use the regenerate button on any faulty image to request a fix; approve with "Approve creatives" once you are happy with all of them.
